{{Quote|Don't tell me what I do or do not need to worry about, boy. I don't like having unknown vessels lurking around my system.|Berrida, to Jacen Solo|<ref name="Remnant" />}}
'''Berrida''' was a portly [[Gender/Legends|man]] who served as a [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], reportingly directly to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kurlen Flennic]]. After the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]] was devastated in a surprise [[Battle of Bastion|attack]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], Berrida was contacted by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], who offered his assistance to the Remnant. Solo's overtures included helping the Remnant find Yuuzhan Vong [[Spy/Legends|spies]], teaching their [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] new tactics, and inviting the Remnant to join the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. Reluctantly, Berrida decided to bring the offer of assistance and the invitation of alliance to Moff Flennic.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Assuming I accept the argument, then, what next? Are you asking me to open my staff to your influence? How will I know then that I'm not trading one form of infiltration for another? I don't have to trust you, Jedi, just because you appear to be beating my enemy.|Berrida, to Jacen Solo|<ref name="Remnant" />}}
Berrida was a corpulent [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[General/Legends|general]] who reported to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kurlen Flennic]]. In [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], in which the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaded [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], Berrida was stationed at [[Yaga Minor/Legends|Yaga Minor]]. Following the [[Battle of Bastion|devastation]] of the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]], [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]], retreating Imperial forces regrouped at Yaga Minor along with a small [[New Jedi Order|Jedi]] expedition searching for the living planet [[Zonama Sekot/Legends|Zonama Sekot]].<ref name="Remnant" />

As the Imperial forces regrouped, Berrida was contacted by [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], who offered to assist the Remnant in various ways, including showing their [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] new tactics and helping them find Yuuzhan Vong [[Spy/Legends|spies]]. When Solo inquired as to why Berrida believed the Remnant was attacked, the general stated that although the Yuuzhan Vong had issued no explanation, he believed it was in retaliation for assisting the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] successor government, most recently by sharing information on [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace routes]] into the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] worlds. The information the Remnant had shared allowed the Alliance to [[Battle of Ebaq|ambush]] a large Yuuzhan Vong [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in the [[Treskov system]] and [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Warmaster]] [[Tsavong Lah]], the leader of the Yuuzhan Vong's military.<ref name="Remnant" />

Solo agreed with Berrida's theory and also believed that the only way for the Yuuzhan Vong to have known about the assistance was if they had spies hidden within the Remnant's ranks. Berrida initially believed this to be impossible, stating that they could conduct random security sweeps and checks, though Solo explained that sweeps and checks were useless unless they knew what to look for, and that the Galactic Alliance, along with the New Republic before it, had difficulties with both Yuuzhan Vong infiltrators and sympathizers. In addition, Solo also cordially invited the Imperial Remnant to join the Galactic Alliance. Berrida reluctantly decided to bring the information and the offer of an alliance to Moff Flennic for consideration. Ultimately, although Flennic opposed such an alliance, [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], the man in charge of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]], accepted the offer.<ref name="Remnant" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You're what?''"<br />"''A Jedi Knight, sir. I've come to help you.''"<br />"''Help us&mdash;? And what exactly makes you think we need your help, Jedi Knight? All I see is an overgrown boy in robes.|Berrida and Jacen Solo|<ref name="Remnant" />}}
Berrida was a portly and stubborn [[Gender/Legends|man]]. It was not in Berrida's nature to negotiate, and he was quick to argue with those he perceived as a potential threat. When Jacen Solo attempted to reason with Berrida, the general was quick to claim that the Empire did not need help from anyone. Nevertheless, when provided with evidence that the Yuuzhan Vong had infiltrated the Empire, Berrida was willing to appraise his superior about the situation.<ref name="Remnant" />

==Behind the scenes==
Berrida appeared in the [[2003]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]'', written by [[Sean Williams]] and [[Shane Dix]].<ref name="Remnant" />
